leads.title: DVC pipeline schema/docs not captured (alternative precedent unverified)
leads.detail: The deps/outs/md5 stage-staleness mechanism attributed to DVC is engineering inference from prior product knowledge. Attempts: dvc.org docs page (3x OSError, S17); dvc-schema.json at 4 path/tag combinations (all 404, S16); repo confirmed at treeverse/dvc with tags 3.67.1 etc. (S13, S14).
leads.next_step: List dvc/ package contents at a pinned tag via the git trees API and locate the schema or stage/dag modules; or capture docs from a mirror of the dvc.org site.
leads.affects: proposal.md §3 P3, §11 alternative; if DVC mechanism differs, only the alternative's framing changes (core design is grounded in P1/P2 and W2)

leads.title: DuckDB streaming/out-of-core behavior not fully documented in captured bytes
leads.detail: The 5 GB streaming target rests on DuckDB's in-process columnar design (INFER). The CSV overview page (S12) was captured but only its first 32 KB read (nav-heavy HTML); memory_limit/out-of-core docs pages not captured.
leads.next_step: Capture duckdb.org docs pages: memory limits, out-of-core/operator behavior, and read_csv parameter reference; then run the PROPOSED 5 GB benchmark on the envelope machine.
leads.affects: proposal.md §3 P2, §13 large-data behavior; fallback if disproven: explicit spill-to-disk bound or bounded external sort with declared disk budget

leads.title: nbclient / clean-execution precedent not directly captured
leads.detail: Clean replay is modeled on nbclient-style fresh-kernel execution, asserted via the nbformat execution_count semantics (S1) rather than nbclient's own docs/code.
leads.next_step: Capture nbclient README/docs at a pinned tag and its roadmap/papermill relationship; verify clean-run guarantees (fresh namespace, allow_errors flags, kernel restart between runs).

leads.title: nbformat 4.5 cell-id requirement: version applicability of the 'id' field
leads.detail: Captured schema (main @ 4346f97c) requires code cells to have 'id' (S1). Which nbformat package version began requiring/emitting ids on write (believed 5.1.0 era, nbformat_minor 4.5) was not verified from release notes; tagged schema path 5.10.4 404'd (S15).
leads.next_step: Fetch nbformat CHANGELOG at a valid tag; verify when ids became required and how readers handle missing ids (downgrade behavior).
leads.affects: proposal.md §3 P1, §13 critical dependency (ecosystem tools dropping ids would break provenance keys)

leads.title: Recovery/locking mechanics are design proposals
leads.detail: Atomic save via temp+rename+fsync, journal reconciliation on open, single-writer lockfile: described in proposal §9 but no crash-injection test was executed.
leads.next_step: PROPOSED witness: kill a writer mid-save, reopen, assert outputs are 'unverified' and notebook file parses; test stale-lock clearing UX.

leads.title: Open upstream defects to track (no Bench-side fix possible)
leads.detail: DuckDB #25824 (silent rounding past sample_size; open at capture 2026-09-24, longstanding across 1.1.3..main per reporter matrix, S5) and the by-design #17599 sampling behavior (S6) remain live hazards even with engine pinning: a pinned engine with a known sampling defect stays defective.
leads.next_step: Track #25824 for a fix release; in Bench, default imports to explicit contracts (never pure auto-detect) and expose store_rejects-style reject counts in import reports.

leads.title: Optional interchange investigation: Arrow IPC / Parquet as canonical derived format
leads.detail: Brief invites investigating a standard interchange format beyond the notebook document. Arrow IPC/Parquet for outputs/cache was considered but not researched this run.
leads.next_step: Evaluate Parquet for content-addressed output artifacts (schema embedding, stable ordering guarantees) vs raw-JSON outputs.

leads.title: Sandbox primitive selection per platform
leads.detail: Proposal specifies OS-level confinement (namespace/bubblewrap/container-class) with a declared-access degraded mode; no specific technology was benchmarked or verified this run (the experiment harness's own systemd/bwrap isolation appears in execution receipts but is not evidence about product behavior).
leads.next_step: PROPOSED: sandbox escape test suite (network bind, out-of-root file read, cgroup limit breach) per candidate primitive on Linux first.
